Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great context on your recommendation use case. Attaching a two-page recap and a short pilot outline for the team to review. High-level notes:
- Objective: reduce p95 latency for interactive recommendations to <=250ms and decrease per-token spend ~30%.
- Approach: 4-week pilot with a small dedicated pool, KV caching enabled for repeat prompts, and production-like canary traffic for regressions.
- Minimal integration: one dev + one infra engineer to wire the evaluation hooks.

I've attached discovery-summary.pdf and pilot-outline.xlsx. If this sounds relevant, I can send a one-click calendar link for a 20-minute kickoff to agree on metrics and data access. If not, a quick "not a fit" helps us file this.

Best,
